notes.title: Demo release!!!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, this is Dei. ːsteammockingː

I'm very happy to tell you that the CPA: Report Bousy demo is finally available.

I know the announcement was made a bit late after the actual release, but it was important for me to take a break, finish some "art" for the actual game, and take some time to sit down and watch some people play it.

In these past 3 days, I've already fixed only 2 bugs. For now, I'm glad to see that taking a lot of time to fix bugs and optimize before the release was well rewarded.

So, what's next? Well, I'll try to take a break over the weekend and then start working on fixing and adding some new stuff for the demo. Then, I'll continue finishing the "arcade" mode to have another option for you guys to have fun :)

I really appreciate all the nice comments, wishes, and criticisms right now.

Thanks for playing the demo, and don't forget to use the hashtag Bousy (on any social media), so it'll be easy for me to see some videos and art about the game. ːsteamhappyː
